# cloptima_llm_provider_credential (Resource)

A BYOK provider credential stored securely by Cloptima. Changing provider_name, display_name, api_version, region, or project_id replaces the resource; api_key and api_base can be rotated in place.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Credential display name, unique per (customer, provider) among non-revoked credentials.
- `provider_name` (String) Provider name, e.g. openai, anthropic, vertex_ai, bedrock. Named provider_name, not provider, because Terraform reserves "provider" as a resource meta-argument.

### Optional

- `api_base` (String) Custom provider API base URL, if applicable. Changing this value triggers a rotate alongside api_key.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Provider API key. Required for standard BYOK providers. Changing this value triggers a rotate, not a replace.
- `api_version` (String) Provider API version, if applicable.
- `project_id` (String) Provider project ID, if applicable.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth refresh token for providers using oauth_refresh mode (e.g. openai_codex). Sent to Cloptima at creation and retained in Terraform state, but never returned by Cloptima. Changing this value forces replacement.
- `region` (String) Provider region, if applicable.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `credential_location` (String) Credential location: cloud or edge.
- `credential_mode` (String) Credential mode, e.g. byok.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `id` (String) Credential ID.
- `status` (String) Validation status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
